description:
Subject: Upcoming Theme Adjustments

Hi team,

We’re rolling out a few targeted updates to the design system. In the palette module, the **primaryColor** handled by the **applyPalette** function will be switched to the new hex value **#ff5733**. Meanwhile, the **buttonBorderRadius** property under **styleButtons** is being eliminated entirely, so any existing radius settings will be removed. Lastly, the typography settings will see **headerFont** updated by the **setTypography** routine, replacing the current specification with **Roboto, sans-serif**.

Please incorporate these changes into your respective components and let me know if any issues arise. Thanks!
